blocks.text: The Google Sheets connector allows you to upload files from your Google Sheets to the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform.
The Google Sheets connector retrieves data from a specified Google Sheets spreadsheet (Spreadsheet ID) and can optionally filter by specific sheets within the spreadsheet.
To configure the Google Sheets connector, you need the source authentication configuration. The following parameters are required.

blocks.item: To allow the SecOps platform to access your Google Sheets via API, ensure that your Google Sheets API is enabled.
To enable the API for your project:
Log in to the Google Cloud console.
From the left-side navigation, click APIs & Services > Library.
Search for and select Google Sheets API.
To learn more, refer to the Google Cloud documentation.
The following parameters are required for authenticating the Google Sheets connector:
To generate a client ID and client secret:
Log in to the Google Cloud console.
From the left-side navigation, click APIs & Services > Credentials.
From the Create credentials drop-down menu, select OAuth client ID.
The Create OAuth client ID page appears.
On the Create OAuth client ID page:
Name: Enter a name for the authentication credentials.
In the Authorized Redirect URIs section, click Add URI and enter https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground.
The OAuth client created window appears, displaying the generated client ID and client secret.
Copy the client ID and client secret.
Select the Use your own OAuth credentials checkbox.
Enter the obtained Client ID and Client Secret values.
From the left-side navigation, in the Step 1 section, select Google Sheets API v4, select all the scopes, and click Authorize APIs.
When prompted, select your Gmail account and click Allow.

In the Step 2 section, click Exchange authorization code for tokens, enter the authorization code, and click Exchange authorization code for tokens to generate and display the access token and refresh token.
Copy and save the refresh token.

blocks.text: To create the Google Sheets data source in the SecOps platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Google Sheets data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Google Sheets Authentication window appears.
In the Google Sheets Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.
Enter the spreadsheet ID located in the spreadsheet URL. The spreadsheet ID can be found in the URL of the Google Sheets spreadsheet you want to ingest, between d/ and /edit.
For example, if the URL is https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/8J31VsFnlj_9hSfWHAJKCBN5aF3J0lVh9opFewIUaKJs/edit, the spreadsheet ID is 8J31VsFnlj_9hSfWHAJKCBN5aF3J0lVh9opFewIUaKJs.

You can filter the specific sheets in the spreadsheet that you want to ingest. To retrieve data from specific sheets, enter a comma-separated list of sheet names in the field. If the field is left empty, data is retrieved from all sheets in the spreadsheet.

blocks.text: For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
